text: I find this app so much more interesting tha other breathing pacers. The aesthetics are the best, and I enjoy the flexibility of customizing my practice. I really like the educational aspect as well. It assumes no prior knowledge and is great for beginners! Thank you for creating this product. Update: I have now bought the lifetime subscription to the Guru version and thoroughly enjoy it. I appreciate how many new trainings are available and new tracking and health testing options! Extremely imp
review_texts: The app is a gem & completely underrated. The creators of the app aproached it just right: with elegant minimalism and full health benefits in mind. I'm very happy with this app! It makes me feel good, it helps me with my anxiety. The interface is so simple and yet inviting, and the sounds are so pleasing to the ear, that i look forward to using this app. I'm considering buying a premium version not because i need to or have to , but as a genuine desire to express my appreciation to developers.

This app more than well worth the one time payment to support the developers. It took a little bit of digging to find that there's a wealth of additional content, updated every so often, at no extra cost. I love this app so much. It really stands out as one of a kind. Highly customizable, intuitive with a beautiful user experience.

Extremely impressed. A huge chunk of time had to go into building this app; it has an endless amount of features including a vast library of various pranayama techniques by which to choose from as-is or you can edit them. All of the pranayama styles are directly linked to Wikipedia by means of being directly associated with this particular app. It trains, teaches, keeps track of all your practice sessions, and has an abundance of customization options. HIGHLY recommend. Worth the cost to upgrade

Gave it a 4 only because I'm only 3 day's in. Really like it so far. Two years in now. This is the only breath pacer that I have used consistently so I can't make comparisons but this one I know. This app is solid gold. The developers are right there when you need them. They listen to the users and make changes based on input. There is a User Wiki available that is comprehensive and regularly updated. Solid Gold.

So far this seems excellent. Huge library of instantly importable exercises, all totally customizable. I have been able to increase my HRV, and decrease HR and breath rate, in a very short time, after a lifetime of bad habits. Zero glitches so far - been using for about a month. ~~~ UPDATE January 2023 Been using this app for five months now. It is excellent. Zero problems, ever. Super user friendly, super customizable, huge inventory of exercises (far more than anyone would ever need).

review_texts: The app is a gem & completely underrated. The creators of the app aproached it just right: with elegant minimalism and full health benefits in mind. I'm very happy with this app! It makes me feel good, it helps me with my anxiety. The interface is so simple and yet inviting, and the sounds are so pleasing to the ear, that i look forward to using this app. I'm considering buying a premium version not because i need to or have to , but as a genuine desire to express my appreciation to developers.

This app more than well worth the one time payment to support the developers. It took a little bit of digging to find that there's a wealth of additional content, updated every so often, at no extra cost. I love this app so much. It really stands out as one of a kind. Highly customizable, intuitive with a beautiful user experience.

Extremely impressed. A huge chunk of time had to go into building this app; it has an endless amount of features including a vast library of various pranayama techniques by which to choose from as-is or you can edit them. All of the pranayama styles are directly linked to Wikipedia by means of being directly associated with this particular app. It trains, teaches, keeps track of all your practice sessions, and has an abundance of customization options. HIGHLY recommend. Worth the cost to upgrade

text: Wow! Very impressed by this totally free learning app. It's well-structured, easy to navigate, and quite intuitive. The graphics are fun and cute and attractive to even my 4 year old son, making him want to learn along with me! Because of the simple and easily navigated design, it loads quickly and easily and it downloads the lessons only when you go to use them, leaving your hard drive free of unnecessary content until you're actually ready to use it. Would definitely recommend this app to anyo
review_texts: Wow! Very impressed by this totally free learning app. It's well-structured, easy to navigate, and quite intuitive. The graphics are fun and cute and attractive to even my 4 year old son, making him want to learn along with me! Because of the simple and easily navigated design, it loads quickly and easily and it downloads the lessons only when you go to use them, leaving your hard drive free of unnecessary content until you're actually ready to use it. Would definitely recommend this app to anyone beginning to learn Mandarin Chinese! And I'm looking forward to sharing in this learning experience with him! 👦‍👩💓

Started learning with the kids at school when the Mandarin teacher came to teach them, and became genuinely interested in learning with my students. Taking it a step further to work on my own, this app is so awesome! Honestly came to work today after just starting this app and the teacher was shocked I was able to know it before she taught the Littles. Super fun, easy, and helpful app! Truly loving it so far!

[10/28/17] Excellent. Has everything. Very easy to use on a daily basis. Has tons of extra little games to build up all of your skills. [8/22/20] I'm using the app again after a long hiatus, and the updates have made it even better. You can review grammar and vocabulary separately, they have live speakers, full conversations to demonstrate, detailed explanations of grammar and pronunciation (which was already there, but is more thorough now), etc. Again, fantastic app. Thank you!

I just got through the first level and so far I love it! It helps with writing, reading, speaking, and listening in Chinese. I like that I can speed through when I want, or I can slow down and repeat things as many times as I like during the level. The app is very straight forward in it's way of teaching. I also like that for the writing part it shows you the proper stroke order of each character, which is very important in Chinese. However, if you are only trying to learn to speak and understand spoken Chinese you can fly through this part and only take a few seconds to write each character. It is good all around for any Chinese language learner... although I am a beginner, so I can't say how it is for advanced speakers yet.

I've had this app for a couple years and it was good when I got it, but over the years they have updated a lot and it's even better than before. They provide multiple ways of learning and practicing the words through visuals, audio, typing, and more while mixing up ways to produce or translate vocab and put it into context. You learn vocab, grammar and syntax and more for written and spoken Chinese. And it's cute. :) As a teacher of language, I am especially impressed and recommend this app!

text: Best App EVER for Comic Collection. The App (for phone) and Cloud (for Web browser) are super easy, well designed and laid out beautifully. The support is always spot-on and quick. I researched high and low for an app to help me inventory my collection. In fact, I tried too many before I bought this one. I use it every time I'm in a comic shop or online shopping. I convinced my brother to get it too, and he loves it. My wife uses their movies collection, and loves it. Awesome job, guys! I love i
review_texts: Great app and even better customer support. I have been using the app to catalog my close to 1500 comics for the last 3 years and it makes it simple when I am out to be able to know what I have and what I am looking for. I just recently signed up for Covrprice which works in conjunction with CLZ to give you values of your raw and graded comics. It also gives you pricing if you are looking at comics out in the wild. Customer support is very prompt at resolving any issues or questions u may ha

I love it. I've been an annual member for 3.5 years now and plan on continuing to use it. The updates we get are great! Thanks to CLZ, my comic book (and graphic novel / Omnibus) collection is so easy to catalog! I can keep track of everything I've got on order and have sold, as well as make a Wish List! The features just keep growing. I gladly paid the $4 annual charge increase, knowing that my collection is in safe hands. Thanks again CLZ!

You would be foolish not to use CLZ. This app is perfect for keeping track of your collection and what you have read, and the customization options are countless. Using CLZ has been an absolute game changer for me (not an overstatement, I promise), and it has been years since I ended up with a dreaded duplicate book or anything like that. Highly recommend!

This app is Amazing! If you are a comic collector this app is a must have. The annual charge is completely worth it. You can have your entire collection saved in the app along with pictures of the covers. It also shows ALL of the variants so you can pick and choose the ones you want to collect. You can when add comics or variants that might not be on the app due to their rarity or newness.

text: The best free app of any kind that I have ever used.   And, amazingly, this app is without advertisements!  Provides abundant, accurate information.  A seriously fun and interactive app with tab views for moon, sun, planets, sphere, sky, and orbits of all the planets in our solar system...reaching all the way out to Pluto (can choose to display planet names, or not).    Top menu provides a rich list of additional information to choose from and view seamlessly with just a click. Elipsis menu has
review_texts: I've been using this app for years and it continues to impress me with every update. It has a great visual interface, will help you find planets in the sky, gives you notifications for any moon phase or other sky event that you want. Extremely accurate information for any location for eclipses, lunar phases, solstices and equinoxes, planetary alignments, and much more. Just a great app!

This is a must have for anyone who is obsessed with the night sky. I've tried other, more well known apps for my stargazing, and none of them have been up to par compared to this one! My fav feature is the moon widget you can add to your home screen, which is basically a calendar for the current moon phase. There are so many neat features on this app and it really is rhe most informative and best designed app that the play store has to offer! 10/10!

Good way to track moon phases and rising and setting times. Really nice widget! Easy to use. Many other great features allowing you to see how all the planets are placed in the sky. Also you can 'time travel' back into the past and forward to the future. No ads. I occasionally donate anonymously using PayPal Thanks for such a great app. It's exactly what I was looking for.

There are few Apps that make it through multiple phone upgrades, this is one of them. Been using daily for years. It has more data than you can successfully use each day, yet is simple to use and self explanatory. I've never once had a crash or glitch, smooth and precise. They really have thought of everything. Also like the widgets for fast info without having to open the app. As a skywatcher and picture taker, I use this app at least 5 times a day, every day. Highest recommendation.

App is extremely detailed and loads up quickly. Has a lot of cool features for people interested in celestial bodies. The feature where you can see your location in relation to the sun and moons postions is really cool and puts the world into perspective. I also like that it shows the planets locations in the sky. Something that I never really thought about before.

text: Love this app, as a mom of 7, I love the info provided, not too technical, but very informative. There are so many features, some I wasn't fully aware of until very late in my pregnancy. A few minor modifications I would like to see are the ability to edit contraction data like you can for kick counts, and on the calendar, change "baby birth day" to "due date". Thanks for such a useful program, I look forward to using your baby tracking app next. This app blows away all the other pregnancy apps
review_texts: I love the simple interface and being able to enter notes in daily as well as see all the notes listed in one place. For me it is the perfect amount of information with one tip per day and some weekly information for mom and baby each week. Just the right items for me. And no invasive ads, either! Just the little tiny strip at the bottom. Totally manageable. Totally helpful.

I like that there's no extra "useless feed" garbage or trying to imitate a social media platform that's usually present in other pregnancy apps. I like that it tells me developments with baby, tips for my own health at each week and a calendar chart highlighting how far along I am on the home page. I also like that it has a clean and simple user interface. My husband uses the app and finds it "quick and useful" to learn what developments are happening with our baby.

I've never rated an app before, but I like this one so much, I decided--why not? The interface is clean and easy to use. Even if you don't opt to pay to remove ads (I actually did, another first!), the ads aren't as obtrusive as in some other apps. I really like the kegel exercise timer and fun facts for each new week. I downloaded a few pregnancy apps initially and quickly deleted them all except this one. Highly recommend!

Great info most of the time, convenient interface, and doesnt have annoying pop ups when unwanted. A great, simple pregnancy tracker. This is my third kid and I used a different app each time. This was my favorite. That said, there are occasional typos and some entries are oddly bossy. Would prefer if they stuck to factual information only. Information the last few weeks becomes redundant and they should omit repeats instead of trying to fill space.

I love everything about this. I can add notes to my calendar, which I basically use as a journal. I love that it gives me a weekly update, as well as daily tips and updates. I can track so many things throughout my entire pregnancy with just this one app and I cannot recommend it enough. Update 2 years later, on my 2nd pregnancy and I'm back to using the same app! I still love everything about it. My 1 gripe is that it doesn't give you the option to switch to twins (which is what I'm expecting)

review_texts: This app is absolutely fantastic. I've used this app for years. Super helpful, I love the design and ease of finding what I want. Easy to search and find verb conjugations, adjectives, kanji, and even counters! Irarely use my Japanese dictionaries anywhere. The handwriting program made a huge difference for me! I've only had a problem with it once, years ago. I contacted the developer, they were prompt and helpful! I love that the app is always making new improvements based on users feedback. I use the JA audio book app, too!

I've been watching the development of this for years. Its solid design, impressively comprehensive, and useful without having to make purchases. The donation based membership cost provides functions that need server support only, and its the work of (as far as I know) one man. If you are serious about learning Japanese, it is the singular source you need to pass all proficiency exam levels.

I can tell, right off the bat, that this app is going to be my go-to for learning and practicing Japanese. I feel like I'm going to get lost in all of the ways I can learn with this app! From listening, speaking, reading and writing to practicing all of those things at once with flashcards or go to the grammar section or read up on cultural blunders one might make, unawares. There is so much to explore. This is the way language learning software should be made!

Well worth the money to unlock all characters. I literally cannot recommend this app enough. What an incredible and convenient way to learn Japanese kanji in the convenience of your phone. Thank yo
review_texts: Excellent app, I've been using it almost every day for a month now. When I open it, I can go straight to reviewing or learning, which I love. A clean interface too, no ads or clutter, so it's easy to navigate and easy on the eyes. The upgrades seemed expensive at first, but after using it for a month and getting through the free 100 Kanji, the ease of use and absence of ads or clutter made the pricing feel completely fair.

Genuinely useful tools for learning kanji, with further access unlocked through one-time payments rather than subscription, and wrapped with a clean & functional UI. I don't even use it at the moment and got a refund by emailing the developer over a month after the purchase ... but when I will need it, I know I'm coming back!

What an incredible and convenient way to learn Japanese kanji in the convenience of your phone. Thank you so much for taking the time to make this app with integrated study tools and additional info on strokes, customizations, and so on. This app is amazing and I can't wait to show anyone interested in learning Japanese.

The best surprise I've ever run across in an app. Impressively thorough with meanings, readings, grammar notes, and usage examples. Easy to navigate and well organized, super customizable, and has plenty of ways to practice and learn. Even includes an extensive, searchable Japanese/English dictionary. Well worth the money to unlock all characters. I literally cannot recommend this app enough.

Very useful app! Worth every penny. This is the most all encompassing kanji app I've found. Being able to create custom sets makes it like Anki, and being able to draw the. Characters, do flash cards style and so much more. The kanji history. I mean, it's ALL here. More info than you probably ever need. There is no better app to pair with what you're using to learn Japanese. I use Human Japanese app (which doesn't teach kanji, just sentence structure and Grammer) and this. They pair perfectly.

review_texts: Excellent app! This has been an awesome introduction to yoga for me, it's private, at your own pace, peaceful, engaging! The UI is super easy and intuitive, really a blessing! For anyone wanting to get into yoga it's a great no pressure place to start that also helps to keep you on track with a schedule. I HIGHLY recommended it!

I'm really enjoying using this app. It makes doing yoga very convenient, and let's face it, it's way more likely that you'll form a new habit if you make out convenient. The routines that I've tried so far are great. It's been a few months and I am so grateful for this app! It really makes yoga accessible. I like that I can look over the poses in each routine and select what I feel suits my needs and energy level for the day.

Really good app. Comes with videos and step-by-step instructions on individual poses, including advanced techniques, and it even tells you when you shouldn't do certain poses (which a doctor will probably recommend studying before doing the complete excercise), and you can see all of this just by tapping on whatever pose after picking a class to either browse or are interested in doing it. I'd say this is a well rounded and complete app as the classes cover just about everything. 5 stars!

I think this application is great. Update. It has been 4 years since i downloaded this app and i still love it. I have recommended this app to numerous of my friends who have found it useful to learn or practice yoga. I am looking forward to any new trainings that they put out . It allows you to kearn the new pay workouts through earning points by using the options available! Such a great idea! And the routines are great for all levels! Work you way up. Update 6.5 years. Love it even more!!!

I've been doing yoga on and off for 15 years or so. I've always used videos and books. This app can take their place! Mostly I like the timing on each pose, plenty to get set, 'hold feel, flow'...vs "flip flop criss cross too fast' by many way more limber models than I. Reminders are great! Best yoga app ever...even motivated my procrastinator wife!

review_texts: I love this app! Does what I need it to and easy to use. I have it on my phone, and use it at the grocery store when shopping for ingredients for my recipes! Good interface with cooking sites, will grab recipes from almost anywhere thru the Share button. From some sites, after download, you may have to edit the recipe, though that's probably not this apps fault. I would highly recommend it.

Love this app. They thought of everything needed to find, file, and use recipes. I'm now in process of getting all my recipes from books, binders, filing cabinets, kitchen drawers, folders, etc., into My Recipe Box. No more hunting for them. I especially like the feature that allows for changing quantities of ingredients. Love this app!

So far this is fantastic! It is so easy to search for a recipe or copy and paste one from the web and you can also add recipes of your own. It also stays open while I am using a recipe and the screen doesn't keep going black! I haven't yet run into the issue of only being able to have so many recipes, so I am hoping that I can add as many as I like. If that is the case, this is definitely a 5 star app!

This is the best app I've had! It features recipe scaling, grocery list generation, nutrition capture, and custom naming structure. This means I can scale my recipe servings up and down, and it adjusts the ingredients automatically. The custom naming feature allows me to sort new untried recipes from the ones I've made. It also has a simple heart rateing so you can note the recipes you family loves. All in all, it is perfect for me in all ways.

So glad I found this app! Easy to import recipes from various sources & they import perfectly - measurements, directions, even pictures. You have the ability to categorize the type of recipe and the best part is the app stays open which is great when cooking! The free version has a video ad for stupid games after each upload but that's the only time you have to suffer through an ad. The app is so good though, I'm considering upgrading to the paid, ad-free version.

text: Original post 2017: It's really easy to navigate, very user friendly and easy to customize. I set the reminder to ask me twice a day how I am doing. It congratulates me when I make an entry which makes me smile and motivates me. Edit Oct 3 2024: I still use this app every day. It's been instrumental in tracking my mental health and I also use it as a diary with photos and notes. I will always make sure I have this app linked to my device. Got a streak of 2563 days and counting! 1000/10 recommend
review_texts: This app has probably saved my life. The interface is intuitive and clean. The functionality is helpful and does exactly what I would want it to. Mental health progress often isn't linear, but tracking things and being aware of it can be very helpful I think. I've been making entries typically multiple times a day for 6 months now and intend to continue indefinitely.

I have a problem with journaling, and other selfhelp apps dont catch my attention. This app has everything I need to track my moods, and the UI is so colorful and easy I cant help but be consistent. Theres a big popup that lets me record my mood on the spot. I can elaborate if I want through personalized emojis, voice, or written memos. But I don't have to. There are graphs and statistics, so my therapist and I use this as a tool to help track my high/low patterns over time. Highly recommend.

I started using Daylio eight years ago or so, kept up with it for a few years and then lost track. I recently picked it back up and the newer interface feels easier to work with and manage more complexity in my day and tracking. I appreciate the thoughtfulness in this app to tracking as well as the way the moods can be interconnected and grouped to facilitate better analysis. It feels accessible and non intrusive so I can still log while I'm feeling low energy.

My SAVIOR to journaling by providing several intuitive ways to journal! Absolutely love the different options for journal entries; and the fringe options aren't bad either. Would love an option for voice transcribe but doesn't affect my 10 STARS. 😉😉😉 Excellent app... Hats off to the developers; well thought out app!

I love this app it's really helpful! I just have a suggestion for the app that I'd love to be added. I'd love if you could add an entry that was just a note without having to add a mood; so when you click the plus, you have a "Note" option! Even if it's premium only (I have premium), I think that'd be super helpful! Love the app, though! Helps me a lot with my mental health. I struggle to stick to a journal and this is so easy and customizable that I actually do it daily. Thank you so much 💙

review_texts: This app is absolutely amazing! I have completely turned my health around using Dr. Greger's methods and I actually understand nutrition now. This is the easiest way I have every found to track my nutrition, I'm not having to count any calories or anything like that. Just simply check off the boxes! An absolute game changer, especially when used in correlation with the books. My life is changed!

Best weight loss app. Over the past 12 weeks, my partner and I have lost over 35 lbs each and we're still losing. The most I've ever lost before was 5lbs through calorie counting. But using this app, I've been able to eat until I'm full. We've also lowered our blood pressure and cholesterol, plus we feel great. It did take about 3 weeks for my sense of taste to adjust, but it's worth it because now whole foods taste much better. My kids are also eating more healthy now.

This App works great. Most of the changes I have made to fit in the daily dozen have actually made me enjoy my food more. For instance, when I make pizza now I add in spinach to the tomato sauce to get greens, and this tastes great. For breakfast, I eat frozen berries (defrosted) with various combinations of apples, flax meal, walnuts, nut butters, and so on, and I really look forward to this now. I think a complete fod journal is still best, especially for obese people but this App is good.

I don't ordinarily download apps but I was striving to be successful at the daily dozen program, thus downloaded the app. It has made reaching my daily dozen goals so easy. I love the check off format. I love the simplicity of the layout. When I forget how much is a serving of rice , I can touch the grain icon and it will take me to a page with more information about the food. This app is so easy to use. I look forward to learning more about its other facets.

I really like this app and the visual reminder to focus on getting the most nutrient-dense foods into my diet every single day. I'm still relatively new to the Daily Dozen and WFPB, although I've been plant-based for nearly half a year. I hope there will continue to be some modifications to the app as others have suggested. I like having the 21 tweaks available to mark off, too.

review_texts: This app is absolutely amazing! I have completely turned my health around using Dr. Greger's methods and I actually understand nutrition now. This is the easiest way I have every found to track my nutrition, I'm not having to count any calories or anything like that. Just simply check off the boxes! An absolute game changer, especially when used in correlation with the books. My life is changed!

Best weight loss app. Over the past 12 weeks, my partner and I have lost over 35 lbs each and we're still losing. The most I've ever lost before was 5lbs through calorie counting. But using this app, I've been able to eat until I'm full. We've also lowered our blood pressure and cholesterol, plus we feel great. It did take about 3 weeks for my sense of taste to adjust, but it's worth it because now whole foods taste much better. My kids are also eating more healthy now.

This App works great. Most of the changes I have made to fit in the daily dozen have actually made me enjoy my food more. For instance, when I make pizza now I add in spinach to the tomato sauce to get greens, and this tastes great. For breakfast, I eat frozen berries (defrosted) with various combinations of apples, flax meal, walnuts, nut butters, and so on, and I really look forward to this now. I think a complete fod journal is still best, especially for obese people but this App is good.

I don't ordinarily download apps but I was striving to be successful at the daily dozen program, thus downloaded the app. It has made reaching my daily dozen goals so easy. I love the check off format. I love the simplicity of the layout. I look forward to learning more about its other facets.

It did take about 3 weeks for my sense of taste to adjust, but it's worth it because now whole foods taste much better. My kids are also eating more healthy now.

This App works great. Most of the changes I have made to fit in the daily dozen have actually made me enjoy my food more. For instance, when I make pizza now I add in spinach to the tomato sauce to get greens, and this tastes great. For breakfast, I eat frozen berries (defrosted) with various combinations of apples, flax meal, walnuts, nut butters, and so on, and I really look forward to this now. I think a complete fod journal is still best, especially for obese people but this App is good.

I don't ordinarily download apps but I was striving to be successful at the daily dozen program, thus downloaded the app. It has made reaching my daily dozen goals so easy. I love the check off format. I love the simplicity of the layout. When I forget how much is a serving of rice , I can touch the grain icon and it will take me to a page with more information about the food. This app is so easy to use. I look forward to learning more about its other facets.

I really like this app and the visual reminder to focus on getting the most nutrient-dense foods into my diet every single day. I'm still relatively new to the Daily Dozen and WFPB, although I've been plant-based for nearly half a year. I hope there will continue to be some modifications to the app as others have suggested. I like having the 21 tweaks available to mark off, too.

review_texts: Great App. Extremely easy to navigate between Bible books, chapters, and verses. Font and line spacing can be quickly enlarged for those who may have difficulty reading small font. App allows one to highlight passages, and it reads passages for the reader. Information is for the ad free version.

The app is my every day companion, makes bible reading and study easy. I also take a lot of notes with is t. I am on a journey presently and I didn't have to add the weight of a physical bible to my already overweight luggage. I am totally satisfied with it. Thanks for an excellent resource

I am blessed to find this devotional app. It really elaborate more insight to each scripture used each day.Also an amazing thing I have noticed personally is that every scriptures used daily, truthful speaks to me and fit the moment (eg. Let say what I am going through at that point in time that I'm led to read or what I read may pop up sometime through the day etc)....I don't know how but it happens often. I really appreciate and enjoy reading this devotional messages always. God bless you.

This is a "must have" app for Christian's who want a serious devotional life that will nurture them towards the direction of Christian maturity. I've been reading these devotional for a good three years before I ever downloaded this app. Although the language might be a bit difficult for some, with a little struggle, the benefits reaped far outweigh the time it takes to understand the days entry. A wonderful app and I highly recommend it!

The app is excellent; just needs one thing, a method to get from the devotional material to the Bible without having to go back to the Books of the Bible menu each time. 12/30/2020 - I'm still pleased with this app. It always appears to speak to my heart the areas that the Spirit of God is currently directing me. Also, I found the button to go from the devotional to the Bible Reference without having to go the Books of the Bible menu. Keep up the good work in publishing The Good News

text: This app is horrible. Every time this app is used, the app freezes with a lag-loop. The video freezes, and the audio loops back 10 seconds. When the audio reaches the video freeze point, the stream continues. Then, the cycle repeats continuously, every 20 seconds, until the top of the hour when the next program begins. All of the content in between is lost, too. What the hell, people? Fix this !! There are 5 other problems & I don't have enough characters Where's the option to get my $50 back? T
review_texts: Not happy so far. The default settings to subtitles is ridiculous. Every time I turn it on! I go to bed early, so I watch all the evening programs in the selection of episodes. Every one has subtitles! I cannot advance through commercials easily like I used to. And if this site was like 'Netflix' I would have no commercials. What am I paying for? BTW. No Greta or Rob Schmidt in the que!? Mark me disappointed!

I enjoy the news part of it. I can't stand the breaks. You play the same old clips over and over and over and over and over and over and over and over and over again. I literally can't stand Ronald Reagan anymore because you played that An American Life video 1000 times too many. when you are not playing the annoying American Life videos you play nothing but Kamala Harris ads. it's so annoying that I have stopped watching. Play that stupid Hallmark commercial one more fing time I will delete.

This app is horrible. Every time this app is used, the app freezes with a lag-loop. The video freezes, and the audio loops back 10 seconds. When the audio reaches the video freeze point, the stream continues. Then, the cycle repeats continuously, every 20 seconds, until the top of the hour when the next program begins. All of the content in between is lost, too. What the hell, people? Fix this !! There are 5 other problems & I don't have enough characters Where's the option to get my $50 back?

This is about Newsmax+ - Buffers all the time. After a show is over, get error screen and all sort of gyrations to get back in. You would think if you were going to launch this big change, you would make sure it was of the highest quality. Hope you fix it soon. I've been a Newsmax customer for years, and I don't have an issue paying for the app even if it cost more, if it would just work. Very disappointing.

+1 on frustrating. I thought it was just me, but like many, many other reviewers, the Newsmax app logs me out every day. I use the app on a Firestick. So it is doubly frustrating because I have to use my remote to enter the username and password. Hunt and peck it out. Dear Newsmax, I'm switching back to Fox if you don't get this fixed! Their app is hassle free for me. PS. A compromise would be to save username and password like other apps do. And, my one star is for the app, not the con
